do_not_repeat: Do not use a water-pouring-into-glass recording on thick honey
Do not amplify a plastic honey-bottle squeak to become the foreground acoustic on a jar-to-dipper pour
Place quiet sweet wet texture only with visible honey contact or continuous flow
Check each scene in sync to picture and with headphones before approval; numeric QA alone does not constitute approval
Do not repeat an already rejected same sound bed across separate scenes
reason_for_rejection: Second Pexels source audio track decodes as digital silence and third source has no audio stream. Mixing unrelated bottle squeezing, hands handling syrup, or synthetic drizzles by estimated times cannot establish truthful sound-picture synchronization. Quantitative peak/silence/audio codec QA was incorrectly described as evidence of visual synchronization.
replacement_requirements: Source exact-action location-recorded sync audio or new sound footage with verified direct source audio. Create an observed event map, validate every event against actual video frames, and obtain editorial headphone approval before release. Do not produce a new full master by recycling disliked Foley, forcing continuous audio, or claiming LUFS/silence gates establish AV sync.
